en: Fixed Grep: -o missing an empty match at the end of a file with no last newline, -o with multiline adding an empty line or misnumbering lines in non-UTF-8 files, and -A and -B ignored beside a zero -C
zh: 修复了 Grep 的以下问题：对于末尾没有换行符的文件，-o 会漏掉末尾的空匹配；在非 UTF-8 文件中，-o 配合 multiline 会多出空行或行号错误；-C 为 0 时 -A 和 -B 被忽略
